decisions.reason: Proven government use and connections to over 30 APIS schemes keep results well above aspiration in the firm's core aviation business.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health requirements is weak and results likely fall short of aspiration, but the expanding firm's slack and the product's low running cost alongside its document and passenger data offers allow one more year before problemistic search reallocates it.
Behaviour analysis is central to the firm's specialist detection and airport innovation positioning, so its uncertain results are carried with available slack.
The profiling method is embedded in the integrated aviation security offer and costs little to maintain, so there is no pressing shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The verification platform complements the successful passenger data solution and sits close to the core offer, which justifies continued commitment while results develop.
